newsitem.title: USA: NYSE to suspend, delist NYNEX shares.
newsitem.headline: NYSE to suspend, delist NYNEX shares.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Friday that it will immediately suspend trading in common shares of NYNEX Corp because the company's merger with Bell Atlantic Corp has become effective.

On Thursday the Federal Communications Commission approved the $25.6 billion merger, which creates the nation's largest local carrier and the number two phone company after long-distance giant AT&T Corp.
The NYSE said it is also suspending trading in NYNEX's 9.55 percent debentures due May 1, 2010 and the 8-3/4 percent medium term notes Series B due December 1, 2004 of NYNEX Capital Funding Co.
It said it would apply to the Securities and Exchange Commission to delist the issues.
